migrated: React no longer parses unknown runtime manifest payloads to reclassify domain-intent capability; it consumes the generated contract type.
DomainIntentCapabilityReference is a closed discriminated union with upstream coherence checks.
AST eliminator keeps variant-index correlation instead of widening to Record<kind, (AstJudgment) => R>.

residuals.detail: The CLI projection still invokes routeActionIdentityCapabilityAuthority.resolve. Move resolution to upstream manifest construction and pass the closed identity contract through wiring before claiming runtime-wide migration complete.
Parser/scanner still produces AST classification; continue splitting syntax recognition from semantic judgment production using the AST semantic producer interface.
A total strategy-to-evidence Record remains upstream. It is not runtime classification, but can be migrated to a relation catalog if Record-free reasoning algebra is a hard requirement.
Origin rule totality currently uses Record in upstream authority; not a downstream/runtime classifier.
Generator emits target control flow based on already-closed execution-signature fields; verify every branch is a projection of an upstream contract, not fresh semantic inference.
